title: WorkHarbor workspace manifest (workharbor.json), schema_version 1 and proposed schema_version 2
description: Language-neutral description of the manifest. schema_version 1 is the accepted form read today by the host agent resolver (apps/host_agent/internal/config/resolver.go) and scripts/check_repo.py: exactly four fields. schema_version 2 is PROPOSED by owner decision H77 (2026-10-17, wave 1a): the same four fields plus optional name, start_dir, human_shell, console_mode, shortcuts, project and helper_images (home clone/backup amendment, 2026-10-29); the resolver rejects it until a separate, reviewed resolver change lands, which keeps the extension fail-closed. Strict JSON: UTF-8 without BOM, duplicate keys rejected, depth <= 128, size <= 65536 bytes for whr validate. Path values are exact native strings. Rules beyond JSON Schema, enforced by validators and frozen in contracts/workspace/vectors.json: schema_version must be the integer 1 or 2 (not 1.0), and any case variant of .git is refused as a path component (the resolver compares case-insensitively). Windows-style aliases are refused too, fail-closed: after dropping the format characters U+200B to U+200F, U+202A to U+202E, U+206A to U+206F and U+FEFF and folding U+FF0E to a dot and U+00A0 and U+3000 to a space, a component made only of dots and spaces ('.. ', '...', '. ') is refused, and so is a component whose text before the first colon (an NTFS stream such as '.git::$DATA' or '.git::$INDEX_ALLOCATION') is .git or the 8.3 short name GIT~1 once trailing dots and spaces are removed ('.git ', '.GIT.', 'a/.git./b', '.git' plus U+00A0). project.url is classified for credentials before its grammar: any userinfo on an http or https URL (the scheme compared case-insensitively) or a password in ssh userinfo is manifest.url_credentials; a user starting with a hyphen, or a host that is not dot-separated labels of letters, digits and inner hyphens (no empty label, no leading or trailing hyphen, one optional trailing dot), is manifest.schema. If projects_path is itself unusable, project.path is not compared with it. The path pattern is exact-case and uses lookahead, so it documents the rule and is not executed by RE2; the positive and negative path vectors prove its equivalence with the Go checker. Defaults when a version 2 field is absent: start_dir '.', human_shell fish, console_mode plain, shortcuts on (FR-047/FR-048/FR-049); the WorkHarbor agent-command shell is fixed to bash by policy and is not a field.

canonicalPath.description: Relative, slash-separated, no empty, dots-and-spaces-only or .git component (further Windows aliases are checked by the validators), no backslash, NUL, CR, LF, tab or glob characters; mirrors CanonicalPath in apps/host_agent/internal/config/path.go. Containment and symlink safety are filesystem checks, not schema checks.

bundles.description: Bundle attachments are deferred; the list must be empty.

start_dir.description: Workspace-relative starting directory; '.' is the workspace root. Existence is checked in the runtime before spawning, not here.

human_shell.description: Interactive human shell started by the console; default fish. Agent commands always run in bash by policy; that is not a field.

console_mode.description: herdr starts the terminal workspace manager; plain starts the shell directly. Default plain; herdr is optional.

shortcuts.description: on loads the shared BundleDock shell shortcuts layer; off does not. Default on.

url.description: Desired input only, never a pin: https without userinfo, or ssh (a user name before @ is admitted for ssh only; a user never starts with a hyphen; the host is the resolver's host name: dot-separated labels of letters, digits and inner hyphens, none empty, with one optional trailing dot). No query, fragment, whitespace, control or bidirectional characters; percent escapes must be well formed (checked by validators). whr never fetches it. Stricter than the resolver's origin check by design: scp-like addresses are not accepted here. Ports are 1 to 65535 and the path has no empty component (checked by validators).

path.description: projects_path + '/' + name, where name is the last path component of url with one trailing .git removed and matches [A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*; validators check containment against projects_path (the pattern cannot).

name.description: Suggested workspace name for 'ws create' (an input, not an identity). Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, 1-64 characters, no leading or trailing hyphen; the grammar is to match the future owner-API workspace name rule and changes only together with it.

base.description: Digest-pinned minimal base image (for example busybox or alpine) providing /bin/sh, tar and find, used by whr workspace home clone and backup. A registry/repository path with at least one slash, an optional tag and a mandatory @sha256 digest. whr init writes it only when given --helper-base-image and never pulls it.

helper_images.description: Optional, digest-pinned helper images for local whr operations; absent unless the owner sets it.
